ledger: Woman with umbrella | walking toward camera, open blue umbrella gripped in left hand (watch on left wrist), whole red apple held in right hand at chest height, smiling | left-facing profile at end, apple resting on open palm of watch-hand, umbrella canopy still overhead | continuous forward walk; turns to her side at ~7-8s while camera pans, background motion-blurred

Red apple | whole, unblemished, gripped in her right hand | whole, unblemished, resting on open palm at shoulder height | carried steadily; appears to sit in the opposite (watch-bearing) hand after the ~7-8s turn, consistent with a hand transfer occluded by her body during the turn

Blue umbrella | open, shaft gripped in her left hand at chest level | open, canopy overhead, shaft descending behind head/shoulder with grip occluded at end | no state change (never closes, never changes color); lower shaft hidden behind her head/shoulder in final profile view

Market pedestrians (man in green shirt, man in white shirt with backpack, woman in red shirt, others) | walking through aisle in both directions | exit frame plausibly | continuous, directionally consistent motion, no teleporting or duplicated walkers

Market stalls and produce (tomatoes, avocados, citrus, apples) | static displays lining both sides | consistent displays as camera advances then pans | no unexplained appearance/disappearance of stalls or goods
Lighting | diffuse daylight plus warm hanging market bulbs | identical at end | no light change without a source change
